summary: Trongsa district is overwhelmingly forested, with 1494.70 km² (82.6 %) of its area covered by forest. Alpine scrubs (128.68 km², 7.1 %) and shrubs (76.97 km², 4.3 %) form the next largest land‑use categories, while meadows, agriculture land and other features occupy only a small fraction of the district.
